title: Parking License Idle Fee Schedule and the Idle Correction Credit
content:
The idle fee schedule re-rates the idle fee lines of a Parking License, and an idle fee line stands at the scheduled idle fee this schedule sets.

## Where the schedule applies

The schedule governs the EV charging idle fee lines billed on a Parking License — the separate line a charging session carries for the time a vehicle stayed plugged in after charging completed. Its result is the correction credited against an idle fee line, so that the line stands at its scheduled idle fee. The correction is booked as a charge reversal credit on the license's parking ledger, pointing at the idle fee line it corrects.

## The correction credit tool

**Capability.** `credit_idle_fee_rerate_1959dfce` posts a correction credit against one EV charging idle fee line of a parking license. One charge reversal credit is added to the license's parking ledger for exactly the amount given, pointing at the idle fee line it corrects, dated today and belonging to the current billing month, and the license's outstanding parking balance goes down by the same amount. The idle fee line itself stays on the ledger unchanged; the resident sees the credit on the parking statement next to that line.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `credit_idle_fee_rerate_1959dfce` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `parking_license_id` | the reference number of the resident's parking license whose ledger receives the credit, as returned by the parking license lookup | identifier |
| `source_parking_charge_id` | the reference number of the idle fee line being corrected, as returned for that line by the parking charges lookup | identifier |
| `credit_amount` | the amount credited against the idle fee line, in USD | a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents); any further digits are rounded half up to the cent when the credit is posted |

**Return.** A receipt with `credit_id` (the reference number of the new credit line), `parking_license_id` (the license credited), `source_parking_charge_id` (the idle fee line the credit points at), `charge_code` (always `charge_reversal`), `credit_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places, the amount credited), `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's posting date) and `resulting_parking_balance` (USD with 2 decimal places, the license's outstanding parking balance including this credit). A receipt carrying `credit_id` means the credit is on the ledger.

## Contract questions

**Does the credit replace the idle fee line?** No. The idle fee line stays on the ledger unchanged; the credit is a separate line pointing at it.

**Which date does the credit carry?** Today's date, in the current billing month, whatever the date of the idle fee line.

*Illustrative call (hypothetical values):* a license referenced PL-0001 and an idle fee line referenced PC-0107 with `credit_amount` 18.50 would return a receipt whose `charge_code` is `charge_reversal`, whose `credit_amount` is 18.50 and whose `resulting_parking_balance` is the license's previous balance less 18.50.
